article_blocks.text: Strain Type: Indica-leaning hybrid
Genetics: Ice Cream Cake × Blueberry Sugar
Breeder: Greenpoint Seeds
THC Content: 18%–26%
CBD Content: Generally below 1%
Terpene Profile: Limonene , Myrcene , Linalool
Primary Flavors: Blueberry, sweet cream, vanilla
Flowering Time (Indoor): 58–70 days
Outdoor Harvest Time: Late September to early October
Indoor Yield: Moderate to high
Outdoor Yield: High
Grow Difficulty: Moderate

Some cannabis strains borrow dessert names because they are vaguely sweet; Blueberry Cake earns the comparison with considerably more precision. Fresh flower can open with the smell of crushed blueberries and berry syrup before vanilla cream, sugary pastry, grape, and a faint earthy spice begin filling out the aroma. Rather than creating another straightforward Cake-family hybrid, Greenpoint Seeds paired Ice Cream Cake with Blueberry Sugar, bringing contemporary dessert genetics together with a berry line that reaches back toward the classic American Blueberry family.

The finished marijuana tends to be dense, frosted, and visually polished, sometimes developing violet or blue accents as flowering progresses. Its effects follow a similarly rich progression, beginning with pleasant mental elevation before moving toward the relaxed, full-bodied calm expected from an indica-leaning dessert cultivar.
Genetics and Lineage

Blueberry Cake combines Ice Cream Cake with Blueberry Sugar. The Ice Cream Cake parent comes from Wedding Cake × Gelato #33 , a pairing associated with dense flower formation, heavy resin coverage, creamy vanilla aromas, sweet dough, and substantial potency. Wedding Cake contributes a kushy, peppered pastry foundation, while Gelato #33 reinforces sweet cream, fruit, and the smooth physical relaxation that became characteristic of many Gelato descendants.

Blueberry Sugar brings a considerably different history into the cross. Its background combines Grape Cream Cake with Blueberry Frosting, adding grape, berry syrup, creamy fruit, and old Blueberry-family influence. The Blueberry Frosting side provides the connection to the famous berry genetics that helped establish blueberry aroma as a recognizable cannabis trait decades before modern Cake varieties appeared. This older influence is especially important because it gives the hybrid more than generic dessert sweetness.

The pairing therefore works through contrast rather than repetition. Ice Cream Cake supplies the dense modern structure and vanilla-pastry depth; Blueberry Sugar pushes the flower toward ripe berries, purple coloration, and brighter fruit aromatics. Seed-grown plants can still vary. Some expressions favor blueberry cream almost immediately, while others show more grape, vanilla, dough, or earthy Cookies character.
Effects and Experience

The initial shift is usually more cheerful than sedating. Mental tension can soften while mood rises, creating a comfortable sense of detachment without immediately dulling awareness. Music, movies, conversation, gaming, or familiar creative activities often fit naturally into this stage because the mind remains engaged even as the pace begins to slow.

A heavier physical component develops gradually. Warm relaxation may spread through the shoulders, back, and legs, while the earlier cerebral lift becomes calmer and less directional. Moderate amounts can create a useful middle ground for experienced cannabis consumers: sufficiently relaxing for an evening at home without necessarily producing immediate couch lock. The experience is generally less suited to demanding work once the body effects become established.

Increasing the dose brings out the dessert hybrid’s stronger indica character. Motivation can fall, appetite may rise, and comfortable furniture becomes considerably more appealing. Potent batches reaching into the mid-20% THC range can produce substantial intoxication, particularly for occasional consumers. Dry mouth, red eyes, dizziness, short-term memory impairment, or anxious thinking remain possible when too much high-THC weed is consumed.
Medical Benefits

For medical marijuana consumers, Blueberry Cake may be most appealing when the desired experience combines emotional decompression with physical comfort. The early mood elevation can temporarily shift attention away from everyday stress or repetitive thinking, while the later relaxation may make muscular tightness, minor aches, or generalized soreness feel less intrusive.

The gradual transition toward a heavier state can also make the cultivar suitable for evening routines. Appetite stimulation may become noticeable, and larger servings can encourage restfulness as the cerebral activity decreases. Someone seeking strongly energizing daytime cannabis may prefer another profile, whereas consumers trying to unwind after daily responsibilities may find this progression more appropriate.

Blueberry Cake has not been clinically proven to treat anxiety, depression, chronic pain, insomnia, appetite disorders, or another medical condition. Effects depend on cannabinoid concentration, individual tolerance, medications, physiology, and dosage. THC can also increase anxiety in sensitive consumers, making conservative dosing especially important when marijuana is being used for therapeutic purposes.
Flavor Profile and Aroma

Blueberry is the defining top note, but the profile rarely resembles fresh fruit alone. Depending on phenotype and cure, it can smell more like blueberry preserves, warm berry compote, or syrup poured over vanilla pastry. Sweet cream follows closely, accompanied by dough, grape, floral sugar, and a subtle earthy Kush background. Grinding the flower often exposes more pepper and herbal depth beneath the bakery-like sweetness.

Beta-caryophyllene can account for some of the peppery spice, while limonene provides brightness that prevents the fruit from becoming excessively heavy. Myrcene fits the ripe berry and earthy foundation, and linalool may contribute softer floral nuances to sweeter phenotypes. Exact terpene dominance varies according to the selected plant, growing environment, harvest maturity, and curing process.

Flavor becomes especially dessert-like on the inhale. Berry sweetness and cream appear first, sometimes suggesting blueberry cheesecake, frosting, or vanilla custard. Grape and pastry notes fill the middle before the exhale introduces earth, pepper, and a faint herbal finish. Unlike aggressively gassy modern weed, fuel usually remains secondary here. The cultivar’s best expressions are memorable because the berry flavor persists after the smoke is gone rather than disappearing behind generic sweetness.
Growing Information

Blueberry Cake is a feminized photoperiod hybrid with an indoor flowering window of approximately 58–70 days. Structurally, the cross combines the sturdier, closely spaced growth associated with Ice Cream Cake with the vigor and broader canopy potential of Blueberry Sugar. Most plants remain manageable indoors, typically showing moderate rather than extreme stretch after the flowering cycle begins.

Topping works well for building several main flowering branches, while low-stress training can spread the canopy before bud formation becomes advanced. Dense foliage should be managed selectively rather than stripped aggressively. Removing weak interior growth and a limited number of leaves around congested areas allows light and airflow to reach developing flowers while maintaining enough healthy foliage to support vigorous growth.

During late bloom, calyxes can become thick and heavily resinous, sometimes picking up blue or purple pigmentation. Dense flower formation makes humidity control increasingly important, particularly once trichomes begin covering the surrounding sugar leaves. Approximately eight-and-a-half to ten weeks provides a realistic working range rather than a fixed harvest date. Outdoors, favorable plants can finish from late September into early October, although climate and phenotype influence timing. Harvest should ultimately be guided by trichome maturity and flower development rather than color alone.
FAQ
What are the genetics of Blueberry Cake?

The Greenpoint Seeds version covered here is Ice Cream Cake × Blueberry Sugar. Ice Cream Cake comes from Wedding Cake × Gelato #33, while Blueberry Sugar brings Grape Cream Cake and Blueberry Frosting genetics into the pedigree.
Who bred Blueberry Cake?

Greenpoint Seeds produces this documented version of Blueberry Cake. Other unrelated cannabis cultivars have also been released under the same name, making breeder identification important when researching genetics.
Is Blueberry Cake indica or sativa?
It is best described as an indica-leaning hybrid. The opening effects can remain cheerful and mentally engaging, but physical relaxation generally becomes more prominent as the experience develops.
What does Blueberry Cake taste like?

The dominant flavors typically include blueberry, sweet cream, vanilla, grape, pastry dough, and mild earthy spice. Certain phenotypes can taste especially similar to blueberry frosting or a creamy berry dessert.
How long does Blueberry Cake take to flower?

Greenpoint Seeds lists a flowering range of approximately 58–70 days. Most indoor plants should therefore finish within roughly eight-and-a-half to ten weeks, depending on phenotype and cultivation conditions.
Final Thoughts on Blueberry Cake

Blueberry Cake works because its dessert character comes from two genuinely different directions. Ice Cream Cake brings dense modern flower, vanilla cream, dough, and the heavy resin associated with Wedding Cake and Gelato genetics. Blueberry Sugar introduces ripe berries, grape sweetness, color potential, and a connection to much older Blueberry-family cannabis. Together they create more depth than simply adding another sweet cultivar to the Cake category.

The plant also offers a useful balance between boutique flower quality and practical cultivation . Its flowering period remains manageable, canopy growth responds well to training, and mature buds can combine excellent trichome coverage with striking berry aromatics and occasional purple-blue coloration. For consumers, the experience moves from an easy cerebral lift into progressively deeper physical relaxation without losing the creamy fruit flavor that defines the strain. Blueberry Cake ultimately delivers exactly what its name promises, but with enough genetic depth, peppery earth, and cannabis character to keep the profile from tasting like sweetness for sweetness’s sake.
